The primary subject is the top red lens which is illuminated, showing a distinct crescent-shaped highlight/reflection. Below it are two unlit lenses (presumably amber and green) covered by visors. A second, smaller traffic light is visible in the background to the right, also showing a red light. The housing appears dark gray or black. Wires or mounting arms are faintly visible at the top.

The connection point at the very top where the wires meet the housing is somewhat indistinct and muddy, lacking clear mechanical detail (bolts/brackets), appearing slightly 'melted' into the background.
